# Load Libraries

```{r libraries, message=FALSE}
packages <- c("here", "readxl","tidyverse", "rstatix", "ggpubr", "knitr")
new.packages <- packages[!(packages %in% installed.packages()[,"Package"])]
if(length(new.packages)) install.packages(new.packages)
sapply(packages, library,character.only = TRUE)

options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))
options(digits = 10)

library(openxlsx)

```

# Data Wrangling
```{r data wrangling}
df_match <- read_csv("(pretest-fullprofile)MatchesToSlides.csv")
df_name <- read_excel("./1-4-22+Twitter+Profile-Full+Experiment+Description+Pretest_January+10%2C+2023_09.06.xlsx", n_max = 0)%>%
  names()

df_Qualtrics <- read_excel("./1-4-22+Twitter+Profile-Full+Experiment+Description+Pretest_January+10%2C+2023_09.06.xlsx",
                              sheet = "data",
                              skip = 2,
                              col_names = df_name) 

df_Qualtrics_long <- df_Qualtrics %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = `1_feelings_therm_1`:`3_PO_TARGET`, 
               names_to = c("FullNo", "Attributes"),
               names_pattern = "(\\d)_(.*)",
               values_to = "Value")

df_Qualtrics_l2w <- df_Qualtrics_long %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "Attributes",
              values_from = "Value") %>%
  rename(feelings_therm = feelings_therm_1)

df_Qualtrics_l2w$FullSet_ID <- "NA"
df_Qualtrics_l2w$FullSet_url <- "NA"

for (i in 1:nrow(df_Qualtrics_l2w)) {
  
  df_Qualtrics_l2w[i,(ncol(df_Qualtrics_l2w)-1):ncol(df_Qualtrics_l2w)] <- 
    df_Qualtrics_l2w[i,colnames(df_Qualtrics_l2w %>% select(ends_with(df_Qualtrics_l2w$FullNo[i])))]

}

```

# Summary by group: PO_TARGET
  
```{r}
PO_TARGET_ttest_bymturkerPartisan <- df_Qualtrics_l2w %>%
  subset(party_binary != 0) %>%
  compare_means(PO_TARGET ~ party_binary, data = .,
                group.by = "FullSet_ID", 
                method = "t.test")
PO_TARGET_ttest_bymturkerPartisan

PO_TARGET_Sum_byRaterParty <- df_Qualtrics_l2w %>%
  subset(party_binary != 0) %>%
  group_by(FullSet_ID, FullSet_url, party_binary) %>% 
  get_summary_stats(PO_TARGET, type = "mean_sd") %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = n:sd,
              names_from = party_binary
              ) %>%
  left_join(PO_TARGET_ttest_bymturkerPartisan, by = "FullSet_ID") %>%
  left_join(df_match, by = "FullSet_ID")
PO_TARGET_Sum_byRaterParty

```

# Summary by group: feelings_therm

```{r}
FT_ttest_bymturkerPartisan <- df_Qualtrics_l2w %>%
  subset(party_binary != 0) %>%
  compare_means(feelings_therm ~ party_binary, data = .,
                group.by = "FullSet_ID", 
                method = "t.test")

FT_ttest_bymturkerPartisan

FT_Sum_byRaterParty <- df_Qualtrics_l2w %>%
  subset(party_binary != 0) %>%
  group_by(FullSet_ID, FullSet_url, party_binary) %>%
  get_summary_stats(feelings_therm, type = "mean_sd") %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = n:sd,
              names_from = party_binary
              ) %>%
  left_join(FT_ttest_bymturkerPartisan, by = "FullSet_ID") %>%
  left_join(df_match, by = "FullSet_ID")

FT_Sum_byRaterParty

```


# Write Results into EXCEL
```{r}
ls_df <- ls()[str_detect(ls(), "_Sum_")]
for (i in 1:length(ls_df)){
   eval(
    parse(
      
      text = paste0(
        "write.xlsx( x=",
        ls_df[i],
        ", file='OUTPUT_Ttest",
        Sys.Date(),
        ".xlsx',sheetName='",
        ls_df[i],
        "', append = TRUE)"
      )
    )
  )
}

bioprase_lst <- unique(df_Qualtrics_l2w$FullSet_ID)

for (i in bioprase_lst) {
  print(i)
  df_Qualtrics_l2w %>%
  subset(party_binary == 2) %>%
  subset(FullSet_ID == i) %>%
  t.test(PO_TARGET~1, 
         mu=4, 
         data = .) %>%
    print()
}

  
  
```
